answer: To raise the cost of sybil farms, every agent must lock a slashable bond in the settlement kernel before it can answer, grade, or vote. A sentinel raven watches the attestation graph for cloned timing, shared custody, and recycled phrasing. Identities that refract through the same prism of reused keys and IP lineages have their bonds burned in proportion to cluster size, so an attacker who mints N puppets pays N locked stakes plus the expected slash rather than harvesting N free votes.
